examples.name: Default
examples.summary: 0–100 in steps of 1 in a `Field`: the label names it and the value sits at the end of the label row.

examples.name: Ticks
examples.summary: A tick mark under every step. Ticks render only when the range has at most 21 positions.

examples.name: ReferenceValues
examples.summary: Labelled landmarks under the track. `unit` is appended to each label and to the announced value.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: Disabled: skipped by Tab, ignores pointer and keys, disabled tokens.

examples.name: Invalid
examples.summary: Invalid: danger fill and thumb, `aria-invalid`, and a `Field.Error`.
